facts.fact: Meenu is one of the forty, a member who cried at the roll leaf; at the Resin House wall she is pressed against the stone.

Rema called the assize at first grey on the morning of ch 25; Devan, Neela, Bhaskaran and eight spearmen leave within the hour and reach the Resin House late afternoon with the sun a hand above the trees.

Neela counts thirty-nine of the forty on the wall; Pavi is outside with the five Kettamala men. Neela rejects a daylight reading at once: a full reading would announce every night-shape to the hunters, and Chathu, first witness at every turning, can still cage regardless.
